# EHS DB

> Comprehensive database of environmental, health, and safety guidelines, standards, procedures, and training resources for workplace safety professionals.

EHS DB provides a centralized knowledge base covering the evolution of the EHS profession since the 1970s, regulatory compliance frameworks (OSHA, ISO, OHSAS), hazard identification methodologies, and practical safety implementation tools. The site serves as both a reference library for safety standards and a resource hub for operational safety procedures and training materials.

## Key Topics

- OSHA compliance
- Occupational Safety and Health
- Hazard identification
- Safety management systems
- ISO standards
- OHSAS-18001
- Workplace safety
- Risk assessment
- Safety procedures
- Incident investigation
- Safety training
- Regulatory compliance
- Safety culture
- Environmental health
- Industrial safety

## Core Resources & Guidelines

- [Home](https://www.ehsdb.com): Homepage explaining EHS profession history and evolution since 1970s
- [EHS Guidelines](https://www.ehsdb.com/ehs-guidelines.php): A-to-Z EHS guidelines and standards reference including OHSAS-18001
- [OSHA Quick Cards](https://www.ehsdb.com/ohsa-quick-cards.php): OSHA quick reference cards for hazards like combustible dust, carbon monoxide
- [Safety Sign, Colors and Poster](https://www.ehsdb.com/safety-sign-colors-and-posters.php): Safety signage standards per ANSI, ISO, and OSHA requirements

## Hazard Assessment & Analysis

- [Job Safety Analysis](https://www.ehsdb.com/job-safety-analysis-jsa.php): JSA/JHA procedures for hazard identification and safe job operations
- [Hazard and Operability (HAZOP)](https://www.ehsdb.com/hazop.php): HAZOP systematic technique for hazard identification and risk management
- [Incident Analysis Methods](https://www.ehsdb.com/incident-analysis-methods.php): Root cause analysis and incident investigation methods for prevention
- [Case Studies](https://www.ehsdb.com/case-studies.php): Industrial accident case studies including Seveso, Sandoz, Windscale

## Safety Procedures & Operations

- [Work Permit System](https://www.ehsdb.com/work-permit-system.php): Safe work permit procedures for hazard identification and control
- [Safety Checklist](https://www.ehsdb.com/safety-checklist.php): OSHA-aligned safety checklists for ladders, stairs, abrasive materials
- [Sling Safety](https://www.ehsdb.com/sling.php): OSHA-compliant sling selection, use, and maintenance guide
- [First Aid](https://www.ehsdb.com/first-aid.php): First aid basics including ABC protocol, CPR, and emergency response

## Safety Training & Culture

- [Tool Box Talk](https://www.ehsdb.com/tool-box-talk.php): Safety toolbox talk resources for workplace briefings and awareness
- [Safety Moment](https://www.ehsdb.com/safety-moment.php): Brief safety talks on topics like asbestos and confined space hazards
- [Behavior Based Safety](https://www.ehsdb.com/behavior-based-safety.php): BBS approach to eliminate unsafe behaviors and reinforce safety culture
- [Safety Slogan](https://www.ehsdb.com/safety-slogan.php): Safety slogans and messages for workplace accident prevention

## Compliance Standards

- [ISO 22000](https://www.ehsdb.com/iso-22000.php): ISO 22000 food safety management system certification overview

## Optional

- [Downloads](https://www.ehsdb.com/downloads.php): OSHA safety checklists and inspection resources for A-to-Z topics
- [Webinars](https://www.ehsdb.com/webinars.php): Archive of free safety webinars from 2015-2018 monthly series
